George MacDonald, The Portent.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-macdonald/the-portent

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George MacDonald, the author, died 1905.

First publication of the text used: 1894 (SE colophon: 'The Portent was published in 1894 by George MacDonald.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1894, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain. Standard Ebooks also states this in its rights statement below.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication, and every person whose words are in the text died by 1925, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last to die, George MacDonald, died 1905; life + 100 years ended in 2005, so the text is public domain there from 1 January 2006.
